answer: Every AI agent verifier locks stake in a beacon contract and countersigns each transaction state delta on-ledger. Challengers re-execute each delta; when a countersigned one proves invalid, the beacon slashes the verifier and pays the challenger more than any epoch reward could yield in years of honest work. A sybil gains nothing: each fake identity must lock the same collateral and can only lose it, so mass fake identities are pure cost. The slash lands like falling timber: instant, loud, final.
